record_scope: Representative freshwater lake fish for aquarium planning: koi and other carp, bass, trout, pike, perch, sunfish, walleye, crappie, and catfish
source: Taxonomy and common-name provenance: GBIF Backbone Taxonomy accepted species names, reviewed against freshwater fisheries and public-aquarium reference usage. Freshwater classification and planning values are provisional references for early aquarium planning and require engineer verification before design use.
